description: This file defines a Timepicker class for a Bootstrap-based time picker widget, including initialization, UI interactions, time setting, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Timepicker
classes.description: A JavaScript class implementing a Bootstrap-styled time picker widget with methods for initialization, UI control, and time management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes event handlers and sets up the widget DOM elements.

methods.name: showWidget
methods.description: Displays the time picker widget, positioning it relative to the input element.

methods.name: hideWidget
methods.description: Hides the time picker widget.

methods.name: widgetClick
methods.description: Handles click events within the widget, executing actions like increment/decrement or toggle meridian.

methods.name: widgetKeypress
methods.description: Handles keypress events within the widget for navigation and time adjustment.

methods.name: elementKeypress
methods.description: Handles keypress events on the input element for navigation and editing.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Parses a time string and sets internal time state.

methods.name: setMeridian
methods.description: Sets the meridian (AM/PM) based on input.

methods.name: setDefaultTime
methods.description: Sets the default time, either current, from value, or specified.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats internal time components into a string.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the current time as a formatted string.

methods.name: setTime
methods.description: Sets the time from a string and updates the widget.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates both the input element and widget display.

methods.name: blurElement
methods.description: Handles blur event on input, resetting highlight.

methods.name: updateElement
methods.description: Updates the input element value with current time.

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.description: Updates the widget display with current time components.

methods.name: updateFromElementVal
methods.description: Reads value from input and updates internal state.

methods.name: updateFromWidgetInputs
methods.description: Reads values from widget inputs and updates internal time state.

methods.name: getCursorPosition
methods.description: Gets the cursor position within the input element.

methods.name: highlightUnit
methods.description: Highlights the time unit based on cursor position.

methods.name: highlightNextUnit
methods.description: Highlights the next time unit.

methods.name: highlightPrevUnit
methods.description: Highlights the previous time unit.

methods.name: highlightHour
methods.description: Highlights the hour input/segment.

methods.name: highlightMinute
methods.description: Highlights the minute input/segment.

methods.name: highlightSecond
methods.description: Highlights the second input/segment.

methods.name: highlightMeridian
methods.description: Highlights the meridian (AM/PM) input/segment.

methods.name: incrementHour
methods.description: Increments the hour, toggling meridian if needed.

methods.name: decrementHour
methods.description: Decrements the hour, toggling meridian if needed.

methods.name: incrementMinute
methods.description: Increments the minute, rolling over if needed.

methods.name: decrementMinute
methods.description: Decrements the minute, rolling over if needed.

methods.name: incrementSecond
methods.description: Increments the second, rolling over if needed.

methods.name: decrementSecond
methods.description: Decrements the second, rolling over if needed.

methods.name: toggleMeridian
methods.description: Switches between AM and PM.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the HTML template for the widget based on configuration.
